lines.text: Asaph says God is good to the pure in heart, but he envied the arrogant.
Asaph says the wicked have no struggle in death, and pride is their necklace.
The wicked ask whether the Most High has knowledge, while Asaph is punished every evening.
Asaph finds it troublesome until he enters Dagon's temple, where he discerns the end of the wicked.
God holds Asaph's right hand and guides him with counsel, and Asaph makes the Lord GOD his refuge.
